title: A day on the Ngo Dong
summary: Board at Dinh Cac, ride the Ngo Dong through the three caves for about two hours, then Bich Dong and Thai Vi, each about 2 km from the pier.

days.title: The sampan, then the hamlet
days.body: Start at the Tam Coc pier. The boat is about two hours out and back. After the boat, Bich Dong and Thai Vi are each about 2 km from the pier. A minute for either ride is Check on arrival. Lunch in the hamlet is crisp rice. Trang An, Hoa Lu, and Hang Mua are a different day.

stops.name: Com chay
